import HartshorneLib.Chapter4CurveDifferentialLattice
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RankOneFrame

/-!
# Local orders of rational differentials

Local frames of the regular differential lattice give coordinates in the
function field. The coordinates depend on the frame; their orders do not,
because changing a frame multiplies it by a unit of the local ring.
This is the local input to the canonical divisor in Hartshorne II.8 and IV.1.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Module FiniteDimensional

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- A chosen frame of the local regular differential lattice. -/
def curveDifferentialFrame (x : X.left) :
    X.left.presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  letI := (curveRegularDifferentialLattice_free_rank_one X x).1
  let b := Module.basisUnique Unit
    (Module.finrank_eq_of_rank_eq (curveRegularDifferentialLattice_free_rank_one X x).2)
  exact (b.equivFun.trans (LinearEquiv.funUnique Unit _ _)).symm

omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] in
/-- The image of a local frame generator is nonzero in rational differentials. -/
theorem curveDifferentialFrame_ne_zero (x : X.left)
    (e : X.left.presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) :
    (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X) ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have he : e 1 = 0 := Subtype.ext h
  exact one_ne_zero (e.map_eq_zero_iff.mp he)

/-- Coordinates of rational differentials in the generic extension of a local
frame. The resulting linear equivalence depends on that frame. -/
def curveDifferentialCoordinate (x : X.left)
    (e : X.left.presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) :
    CurveRationalDifferentials X ≃ₗ[X.left.functionField] X.left.functionField :=
  (basisSingleton Unit (finrank_curveRationalDifferentials_eq_one X)
    (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (curveDifferentialFrame_ne_zero X x e)).equivFun.trans
      (LinearEquiv.funUnique Unit _ _)

@[simp]
theorem curveDifferentialCoordinate_smul_frame (x : X.left)
    (e : X.left.presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) (a : X.left.functionField) :
    curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e (a • (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X)) = a := by
  let b := basisSingleton Unit (finrank_curveRationalDifferentials_eq_one X)
    (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (curveDifferentialFrame_ne_zero X x e)
  change b.repr (a • (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X)) () = a
  rw [← basisSingleton_apply Unit (finrank_curveRationalDifferentials_eq_one X)
    (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (curveDifferentialFrame_ne_zero X x e) ()]
  simp only [map_smul, b, Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.smul_apply,
    Finsupp.single_eq_same, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

/-- A differential is its frame coordinate times the frame generator. -/
theorem curveDifferentialCoordinate_smul (x : X.left)
    (e : X.left.presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :
    curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e ω • (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X) = ω := by
  apply (curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e).injective
  exact curveDifferentialCoordinate_smul_frame X x e _

/-- The rational coordinate of a regular differential is its local coefficient. -/
theorem curveDifferentialCoordinate_frame (x : X.left)
    (e : X.left.presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) (a : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :
    curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e (e a : CurveRationalDifferentials X) =
      algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField a := by
  have he : e a = a • e 1 := by
    rw [← map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [he]
  change curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e (a • (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X)) = _
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul X.left.functionField a]
  exact curveDifferentialCoordinate_smul_frame X x e _

/-- Units of a curve's local ring have trivial valuation in its function field. -/
theorem orderAt_algebraMap_unit {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (a : (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)ˣ) :
    orderAt X.hom hx
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField (a : _)) = 1 := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDedekindDomain X.hom hx
  change (stalkHeightOne X.left x).valuation X.left.functionField _ = 1
  rw [IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_eq_one_iff_notMem]
  exact IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mpr a.isUnit

/-- The valuation of a rational differential's coordinate is independent of
the regular local frame. -/
theorem orderAt_curveDifferentialCoordinate_eq {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (e e' : X.left.presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :
    orderAt X.hom hx (curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e ω) =
      orderAt X.hom hx (curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e' ω) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, _⟩ := existsUnique_unit_smul_frame e e'
  have hcoord : curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e ω =
      curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e' ω *
        algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField (a : _) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← curveDifferentialCoordinate_smul X x e' ω]
    rw [map_smul, ha]
    change curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e' ω *
      curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e ((a : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) •
        (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X)) = _
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul X.left.functionField
      (a : X.left.presheaf.stalk x),
      curveDifferentialCoordinate_smul_frame]
  rw [hcoord, map_mul, orderAt_algebraMap_unit X hx, mul_one]

/-- The integer order of a nonzero rational differential. A frame is selected
internally; `curveDifferentialOrder_eq` proves independence of this choice. -/
def curveDifferentialOrder {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) : ℤ :=
  Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx
    (Units.mk0 (curveDifferentialCoordinate X x (curveDifferentialFrame X x) ω)
      (fun h => hω ((curveDifferentialCoordinate X x
        (curveDifferentialFrame X x)).map_eq_zero_iff.mp h))))

/-- Any regular local frame computes the intrinsic order of a nonzero rational
differential. -/
theorem curveDifferentialOrder_eq {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    (e : X.left.presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) :
    curveDifferentialOrder X hx ω hω =
      Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx
        (Units.mk0 (curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e ω)
          (fun h => hω ((curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e).map_eq_zero_iff.mp h)))) := by
  have hv := orderAt_curveDifferentialCoordinate_eq X hx
    (curveDifferentialFrame X x) e ω
  have hu : Units.map (orderAt X.hom hx).toMonoidWithZeroHom.toMonoidHom
      (Units.mk0 (curveDifferentialCoordinate X x (curveDifferentialFrame X x) ω)
        (fun h => hω ((curveDifferentialCoordinate X x
          (curveDifferentialFrame X x)).map_eq_zero_iff.mp h))) =
      Units.map (orderAt X.hom hx).toMonoidWithZeroHom.toMonoidHom
        (Units.mk0 (curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e ω)
          (fun h => hω ((curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e).map_eq_zero_iff.mp h))) :=
    Units.ext hv
  unfold curveDifferentialOrder orderZAt
  simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [hu]

/-- Multiplying a regular frame generator by a rational function gives exactly
the order of that function. -/
theorem curveDifferentialOrder_smul_frame {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (e : X.left.presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) (a : X.left.functionFieldˣ)
    (h : (a : X.left.functionField) • (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X) ≠ 0) :
    curveDifferentialOrder X hx
      ((a : X.left.functionField) • (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X)) h =
      Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx a) := by
  rw [curveDifferentialOrder_eq X hx _ h e]
  simp only [curveDifferentialCoordinate_smul_frame, Units.mk0_val]

/-- Scaling a nonzero rational differential adds the order of the rational
function to the order of the differential. -/
theorem curveDifferentialOrder_smul {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (a : X.left.functionFieldˣ) (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    (haω : (a : X.left.functionField) • ω ≠ 0) :
    curveDifferentialOrder X hx ((a : X.left.functionField) • ω) haω =
      Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx a) + curveDifferentialOrder X hx ω hω := by
  let e := curveDifferentialFrame X x
  let c := curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e
  let b := Units.mk0 (c ω) (fun h => hω (c.map_eq_zero_iff.mp h))
  rw [curveDifferentialOrder_eq X hx _ haω e, curveDifferentialOrder_eq X hx _ hω e]
  have hmul : Units.mk0 (c ((a : X.left.functionField) • ω))
      (fun h => haω (c.map_eq_zero_iff.mp h)) = a * b := by
    apply Units.ext
    exact c.map_smul (a : X.left.functionField) ω
  change Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx
    (Units.mk0 (c ((a : X.left.functionField) • ω)) _)) =
      Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx a) +
        Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx b)
  rw [hmul, map_mul, toAdd_mul]

end
end Hartshorne
